snippet.title: GORE | Official Gameplay Trailer (Found Footage Indie Horror Game)
snippet.description:
Wishlist NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3943880/GORE/

GORE is a found footage horror experience that immerses players in an unknown mountain range designed to resemble the scenery of the Pacific Northwest in the United States. Drawing inspiration from the many works of Lovecraft, Fears to Fathom: Ironbark Lookout, and John Carpenter’s The Thing, this game pulls you deep into a decaying wilderness where something horrible is rapidly spreading through the surrounding environment. You must discover where this fleshy entity came from, armed with only a flashlight and handheld camera. 

#foundfootage #analoghorror #vhshorror #indiegame #fyp #gore
